content: {"phoneNote": "The double-bordered label card takes up the entire first screen, pushing the great shop photo down so only its top arch peeks above the fixed bar.", "desktopNote": "The olive-label card paired with the arched photo collage gives the page a warm, authentic Istrian deli feel right from the first screen.", "phone": {"impression": 4, "hierarchy": 5, "imagery": 3, "spacing": 4, "clutter": 4, "distinctiveness": 5}, "desktop": {"impression": 5, "hierarchy": 5, "imagery": 5, "spacing": 5, "clutter": 4, "distinctiveness": 5}, "fixes": ["Tighten the vertical padding and olive-branch illustration inside the mobile hero card so the arched shop photo is clearly visible on the first screen.", "Replace the repeated olive-branch graphic in the three 'Na policah' price cards with distinct icons (bottle, salt, gift box) or simply remove it from the cards.", "Merge the 'Naročila darilnih paketov' contact block and the footer so the address, phone number, and email aren't repeated twice in the same dark green section."]}
